hypothesis: A genuine observed loop through shared typed SSA and call-aware allocation removes scalar helper calls and home traffic, preserving exact Python effects, calls, owners and recovery.
checkpoint_requirement: Concrete generated BEFORE/outcome recording and terminal/Python-return pairing, graph/effect/FrameState structures and executable host checks. Report unfinished paths honestly; declarations or fabricated event graphs are insufficient.
completion_requirement: All three reviewed dependency steps: actual recording; shared verified SSA/passes/LIR/register allocation/spills; immutable baseline+native-loop replacement with recoverable entries, statepoints, guards and meaningful mixed-loop fixtures. No partial M3 completion credit.
implementation_contracts: One shared optimizer/LIR/backend/owner; no parallel trace bytecode or runtime selector.
Only the nominated temporary method Unit records. Unrelated baseline helpers acquire no recorder lookup or branch.
Preserve actual boxed identity and exact owner consume/overwrite ordering; releases are reentrant statepoints. Owning boxed temporary operations stay generic until modeled.
Reserve recovery before effects; AFTER recovery cannot allocate or replay effects.
No semantic code/function/object root, old Unit pin or native label across Python callees; fresh return imports all continuation facts.
Separate source words, SSA identities, LIR operations, native labels and recoverable entries in every consumer.
Configuration-proven native poll retains each real periodic service exactly once, with correct source PC and terminal handling.
One recording attempt per State/source stamp, bounded event/graph/state/spill memory charged to the existing process budget; failed optional optimization returns to baseline.
Preserve all28accepted methods, all old opcode formats/IDs and pristine/marshal behavior; no workload or function-name admission filter.
Freeze and independently review exact source before fresh candidate execution.

syntax_only_checks.scope: Actual changed/new TUs and new worktree includes with matching retained configuration; no candidate object/link/config/build-product mutation.

standalone_encoder_checks.scope: Small actual SSA/LIR/allocator/encoder fixtures, including failure and spill paths; host fixture execution only, never emitted machine bytes or candidate executable.

next_gate: Exact source freeze/review, bounded focused native behavior/emission; measured mechanism costs and broad qualification later.
